content: Penicillin G potassium for injection, USP, is provided in a dry powder form and is available in vials containing the following quantities of crystalline penicillin G as the potassium salt: 1,000,000 units (1 million units) in packages of 10 vials (NDC 0781-6134-95), 5,000,000 units (5 million units) in packages of 10 vials (NDC 0781-6135-95), and 20,000,000 units (20 million units) in packages of 1 vial (NDC 0781-6136-94). The formulation is buffered with sodium citrate and citric acid to maintain an optimal pH. The dry powder should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F), as defined by the USP. Once reconstituted into a sterile solution, it can be stored in a refrigerator at 2° to 8°C (36° to 46°F) for up to 7 days without significant loss of potency.
